No photos yet. Buyers scroll right past listings without pictures. Snap at least 4.
Only %1$d photo(s). Add a few more — 4 is the minimum, 6–8 is ideal.
%1$d photos is okay, but 6–8 makes buyers feel safer.
Photo %1$d is blurry. Hold your phone steady or tap to focus.
Photo %1$d is a little soft. Try again with steadier hands or more light.
Photo %1$d is too dark. Daylight near a window works wonders.
Photo %1$d is washed out. Step out of direct sun or away from the lamp.
Photo %1$d looks a bit flat. Softer side light helps the details pop.
In photo %1$d the item looks small. Move closer so it fills most of the frame.
Photo %1$d is cropped too tight. Step back a little so the whole item shows.
In photo %1$d the item is off to the side. Try to center it.
Photo %1$d has a busy background. A plain wall, sheet or table looks cleaner.
Photo %1$d is small (under 800 px). Retake it with the camera, not a screenshot.
Marketplaces show the cover as a square. Crop it to 1:1 so nothing important gets cut.
Photo %1$d is your best shot. Make it the cover?
You marked it \"Has Flaws\" — add a close-up of the flaw. Honest photos mean fewer returns.
%1$d angle(s) from the checklist are still missing. Tag your photos to see which.
No title yet. Tap \"Build title\" to get a good starting point.
Title is only %1$d characters. Aim for 40–70 so it shows up in more searches.
Title is %1$d characters — over 70 gets cut off. Trim it a little.
Start the title with the brand. That\'s what people type in search.
Add the model to the title — it\'s the #1 thing buyers search for.
Add the key variant to the title (size, colour or storage).
Title is mostly CAPS. Normal case reads friendlier and looks less spammy.
Easy on the shouting (\"%1$s\"). A calm title feels more trustworthy.
\"%1$s\" appears twice in the title. Once is enough.
Title looks like keyword spam. Keep it to brand, model, variant and condition.
Most buyers here search in Indonesian. Consider adding key Indonesian words to the title, e.g. \'bekas\', \'second\', \'murah\'.
No description yet. Tap \"Use template\" to start in seconds.
There are still [blanks] from the template. Fill them in or delete them.
Description is %1$d characters. A bit more detail (300+) builds trust.
Description is %1$d characters. Over 1,200 and people stop reading — trim it.
Buyers will ask about: %1$s. Mention it up front and save yourself the chats.
%1$d sentence(s) run over 25 words. Shorter sentences are easier on a phone.
That\'s a wall of text. Break it into short paragraphs or bullets.
%1$d emoji is a lot. Two or three is plenty.
Lots of \"!\" — it can come across as pushy. Keep it relaxed.
Several words in ALL CAPS. Normal case reads friendlier.
\"%1$s\" sounds stiff or salesy. Use casual-polite \"kamu\" and plain words.
\"%1$s\" sounds like an ad. Plain, honest words sell second-hand stuff better.
Title and description seem to be in different languages, or mixed. Pick one per version.
The text doesn\'t match the selected listing language. Switch the toggle or translate it.
Remove phone numbers, WhatsApp or links — Tokopedia and Shopee hide or block them.
No price set yet.
Check what similar items go for so your price is in the right range.
Your price is %1$d%% of the typical price you found. That may scare buyers off.
Your price is only %1$d%% of the typical price. Double-check — it may look suspicious.
